name: CameraShake
src_typeComment: Trauma-based screen shake: call AddTrauma(0..1) on impact (hit, explosion, landing) instead of setting a shake duration/strength directly — trauma decays on its own and stacks naturally from multiple hits. Runs in LateUpdate so it layers on top of whatever already positioned the camera this frame (e.g. SmoothFollowCamera).

src_serialized.name: maxOffset
src_serialized.tooltip: Maximum world-space offset applied at full trauma (trauma = 1).

src_serialized.name: maxRoll
src_serialized.tooltip: Maximum rotation in degrees applied at full trauma.

src_serialized.name: traumaDecayPerSecond
src_serialized.tooltip: How quickly trauma decays back to 0 per second.

src_serialized.name: noiseSpeed
src_serialized.tooltip: How fast the Perlin noise is sampled — higher shakes more erratically.

src_members.name: AddTrauma
src_members.comment: Adds shake strength, clamped to 1. Call with a bigger value for bigger impacts (e.g. 0.3 for a hit, 1 for an explosion).
